instructions:
1. Lie on your back with arms by your sides, palms down.
2. Lift your legs and bend your knees to 90 degrees, thighs vertical.
3. Extend your legs straight out, keeping them off the floor.
4. Bend your knees back in and curl your hips off the floor toward your chest.
5. Lower your hips and legs back to the start with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Curl your pelvis using your abs, not momentum.
2. Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
3. Move slowly on the way down to keep tension on the abs.
4. Exhale as you lift your hips, inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Sit at the lat pulldown machine with knees secured under the pads.
2. Grasp the bar with an underhand grip at shoulder-width, arms fully extended.
3. Keep your chest up and lean back slightly.
4. Pull the bar to your upper chest, driving your elbows down to your sides.
5. Slowly extend your arms back to the start with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive your elbows toward your hips to keep the lats working.
2. Squeeze your shoulder blades at the bottom.
3. Avoid swinging your torso to move the weight.
4. Exhale as you pull down, inhale as you return.

instructions:
1. Stand on the middle of the band with feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Hold a handle in each hand with an overhand grip, arms extended by your sides.
3. Curl both handles up toward your shoulders by bending your elbows.
4. Squeeze at the top, keeping your wrists straight.
5. Slowly lower the handles back to the start with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your elbows tucked and still through the curl.
2. Hold a firm pronated grip to load the forearms.
3. Lower slowly to keep tension on the band.
4. Exhale as you curl up, inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Stand on the middle of the band with your right foot, feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Hold a handle in each hand at shoulder height, elbows bent.
3. Step your left foot back and lower your left knee toward the floor.
4. Keep your right knee over your ankle.
5. Push through your right heel to return to standing.
6. Repeat, then switch legs.
tips:
1. Keep your front knee aligned with your toes.
2. Keep your torso upright throughout.
3. Drive through the front heel to engage the glutes.
4. Exhale as you stand up, inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Sit at the machine with your chest against the pad and feet flat on the floor.
2. Grasp the handles with arms extended forward.
3. Pull the handles back by opening your arms wide to your sides.
4. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
5. Return slowly to the start with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your elbows slightly bent throughout.
2. Lead with your elbows, not your hands.
3. Squeeze your shoulder blades at the back.
4. Exhale as you open your arms, inhale as you return.
